style.styleTitle: Personalised Teddy Christmas Themed Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: The magic of their first Christmas can always be treasured with this adorable Teddy themed bauble and is perfect for a little one that arrived within the last year. As they grows this gift will become a lasting reminder of that first magical Christmas and keep them in the festive spirit for years to come. My 1st Christmas 2024 is fixed text and cannot be changed. Make this bauble extra special by adding a personal message up to 4 lines, as below. Message Line 1 - 20 characters. Message Line 2 - 20 characters. Message Line 3 - 20 characters. Message Line 4 - 20 characters. Personalisation will appear as entered. Bauble comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree. Colour of Ribbon May Vary.
